WITH monthly AS (SELECT month, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net FROM sales_facts WHERE month IN ('2026-03', '2026-04') GROUP BY month) SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-04' THEN net ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-03' THEN net ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-03' THEN net ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS net_revenue_growth_ratio FROM monthly
